newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in dull trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was little changed against the dollar on Monday, dealers said.
They said trading was slow, with some operators seen caught wrong footed as the central bank maintained its fixing rate.
One foreign bank dealer said many operators had speculated a higher fixing which led to some dollar buying at around the 2,329.5 level shortly before the fixing at 0800 GMT.
But he said they were disappointed as the cental bank kept its rate unchanged, triggering some dollar unloading.
The intervention rate was kept at 2,329/2,521 and the conversion rate at 2,329/2,377 on Monday.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,329.20/29.30 at 0900 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,329.80/30.00. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,328.6/29.0 and 2,328.0/28.5, respectively.
One U.S. bank dealer said the central bank had no reason to raise the band because of the current strong inflows of fresh funds to subscribe PT Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) shares.
He said the central bank might have to absorb some dollars from the market if it had raised the fixing.
Dealers said the market focus was on possible implications on money market liquidity following the public share offer by BNI from Monday to Thursday.
The U.S. bank dealer said operators were worried over a possible tightening in the money market following market talk of heavy oversubscription of BNI shares.
The BNI share offer was expected to raise almost one trillion rupiah from the public.
"People are watching the settlement bank. The ball is with the bank," the U.S. bank dealer said. PT Bank Dagang Nasional Indonesia has been picked the settlement bank for BNI shares.
Dealers said the liquidity condition would very much be dependent on whether BDNI would place the money on the interbank market or in central bank papers (SBIs).
The U.S. bank dealer said one- and three-month swaps were weaker, while six-month swap was well supported.
Overnight swap closed at 0.35/0.45 and tom/next at 0.5/0.6.
One-month swap was at 17.00/17.50, two at 34.0/35.5, three at 52.25/53.00 and six at 100.0/101.0 points.
